name: Caravan Streamflow Prediction Benchmark
description: Caravan is a streamflow prediction benchmark for evaluating hydrological models on river discharge forecasting tasks. It is used to compare data-driven and hybrid approaches for predicting streamflow across basins and time horizons relevant to earth science and water resources.
evaluation_method: hydrological forecast metrics such as Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency, RMSE, bias, and correlation against observed streamflow
notes: Typically evaluated across many catchments; performance can differ substantially by basin regime and data availability.
